en: An old sepia photograph mounted on a decorated card showing two adjacent two‑storey houses with tiled roofs and wooden facades. A narrow passage and simple wooden gate stand between them. A man in dark clothes and a hat and a boy stand in front of the buildings. The mount has floral ornamentation in the corners and handwritten captions in a Cyrillic script at the bottom and faintly at the top.
